information_contract.decision: Only after the entire 1/2/5 second leader and contemporaneous follower window is complete.
information_contract.mark: Last actual trade price carried causally for at most 2000ms; stale state is unavailable.
information_contract.rolling_features: All scale, activity and beta inputs end at or before the shock-start boundary; current-shock observations are excluded.

prior_features.activity_baseline: Median positive BTC H-second quote notional across the prior 900 completed one-second endpoints, requiring >=300 positive windows.
prior_features.beta: Prior 1800-second covariance(BTC,follower)/variance(BTC), requiring >=1200 finite pairs and >=100 nonzero BTC returns, clipped to [0.2,2.0].
prior_features.btc_scale: For horizon H, sqrt(H/900 * sum of squared BTC 1s returns over the prior 900 seconds), requiring >=600 finite and >=60 nonzero returns.

promotion_boundary.if_gate_fails: Report the information unit as economically insufficient and do not run PnL or open later dates.
promotion_boundary.if_gate_passes: Freeze a separate causal entry/exit/cost/account contract before reading any additional date or computing PnL.

purpose: Fatal economic-opportunity count only. No trade PnL, exit, risk, leverage, funding or 2024+ evaluation is permitted in this claim.
question: Do completed Bybit BTCUSDT sub-minute price-and-aggressive-flow shocks leave a sufficiently large causal response gap in SOLUSDT or XRPUSDT to justify a full after-cost strategy test?

sources.integrity: Record observed SHA-256, byte size, gzip validity, schema, row count and timestamp monotonicity for every requested file.
sources.venue: Bybit USDT linear perpetual public trades

unique_event_rule.rearm: No new event until BTC signed displacement from the event shock-start is <=25% of the detected shock for ten consecutive 100ms states.
unique_event_rule.same_timestamp_tie: If multiple horizons qualify at the same time they remain separate diagnostic families; no trading slot is simulated.
unique_event_rule.selection: For each follower, date, horizon and gap floor, take the first eligible 100ms decision.
